description: Call this after writing or editing a definition and before simulate_path or publish_form; it checks the structure and engine rules, while simulate_path checks how a user moves through the form. Checks a Formhaus form definition against the JSON Schema and the engine. Returns { valid, issues }. Each issue has code, severity ("error" or "warning"), a JSON pointer path, message, hint and, when a repair is known, fixes: a list of { title, safe, patch } where patch is an RFC 6902 JSON Patch. Errors make the engine reject the definition, such as a condition with zero or two operators, a condition on a later step, a duplicate key, a route to an earlier step, a condition outside a group on a field inside it (group-scope) or a section inside a section (invalid-nesting). Warnings point to likely mistakes, such as a condition value that is not an option, contains on a field that does not hold a list (contains-not-list), a contains value that is not an option (contains-not-in-options), a select without options, next: false without an autoAdvance radio, scale or rating, a scale range outside 3 to 11 points, an anchor outside the range, or matrix rows whose options differ. Fix each error at its path, or apply one of its fixes, and call again. To apply every safe fix at once, call fix_definition.

definition.description: Formhaus form definition as a JSON object or a JSON string. JSON Schema: https://formhaus.dev/schema/form-definition.json. Top level: id, title, submit { label }, and fields (one step) or steps [{ id, title, fields }]. Field: { key, type, label, validation?, options?, show?, showAny? }. Rules go inside "validation": { required, minLength, maxLength, min, max, pattern, matchField }. Condition: { field, eq | neq | in | notIn | contains | notContains | notEmpty | gt | gte | lt | lte } with exactly one operator, on a field of the same or an earlier step. Optional: lang, messages and labels catalogs, and i18n objects that map texts to translation keys.

name: validate_definition

issues.description: Errors first, then warnings. Fix every error at its path and validate again.

fixes.description: Ready repairs for this issue. Apply one patch to the definition, then validate again.

patch.description: RFC 6902 JSON Patch operations (add, replace, remove, move) with JSON pointer paths.

safe.description: true when applying the patch only repairs the issue and changes nothing else. fix_definition applies these.

path.description: JSON pointer to the node, such as /steps/0/fields/1/show/0/field.

valid.description: false when at least one issue has severity "error".

title: Validate a Formhaus definition
